summary: This page contains the Table of Contents for an SGX REIT annual report, listing sections such as Key Figures on page 4 and Financial Statements on page 172 without providing any specific financial data, portfolio statements, or tenant details.

This page presents the Key Figures for the financial year ended 31 December 2025, featuring a Debt Maturity Profile table detailing €63.5m to €200.8m maturities by portfolio type and date, alongside portfolio valuation data of €798.1 million reported in euros with geographic breakdowns. The content includes gross revenue (€50.4 million), net property income (€32.8 million), distribution per unit (1.09 cents), weighted average lease expiry (5.6 years), and weighted average interest rate (2.8%), all expressed in euros.

This page presents the SGX REIT's key portfolio financial highlights as of 31 December 2024, featuring an audited Portfolio Statement showing an occupancy rate of 89.4% and aggregate leverage of 44.6%, alongside regional breakdowns for Germany (80.6%), Spain (80.3%), and France (100%) plus a debt maturity profile by year.

This page features the Chairman and CEO Letter to Unitholders for IREIT Global Group Pte. Ltd., reporting FY 2025 gross revenue of €50.4 million (a 33.3% decrease) and net property income of €32.8 million (a 38.7% decrease). No schema-relevant data such as audited portfolio statements, total return tables, or specific financial highlights are present on this page.

This page presents €50.4m gross revenue for the reporting period and details strategic portfolio diversification into retail (France) and hospitality (Berlin Campus) sectors through specific acquisitions and new leases. No audited Portfolio Statement, financial highlights table, or tenant mix data is present on this page.

This page details the organizational hierarchy of IREIT GLOBAL through two diagrams: the Trust Structure, which outlines relationships among UNITHOLDERS, MANAGER (IREIT Global Group Pte. Ltd.), TRUSTEE (DBS Trustee Limited), PROPERTIES, and PROPERTY MANAGERS; and the Manager Structure, which depicts governance under the BOARD OF DIRECTORS and operational departments including Investment and Asset Management, Finance, Investor Relations, and Compliance.

This page presents the **Statement of Total Return** for IREIT and its subsidiaries ("IREIT") reporting financial data in **€'000**, detailing a total loss attributable to Unitholders of €63,200 for FY 2025 alongside distribution details and unit counts. The accompanying text explains that gross revenue and net property income decreased significantly due to vacancy at Berlin Campus and higher finance costs driven by increased loan margins on the German and Spanish Portfolios.

This page presents the Revenue by Geography and Net Property Income by Geography for FY 2025, reporting total revenue of €50.4 million and net property income of €32.8 million with breakdowns by German (42.3% / 32.8%), French (38.5% / 49.5%), and Spanish (19.2% / 17.7%) portfolios respectively. The reporting unit is stated as €.

This page presents the Balance Sheet and Capital Management section of the IREIT annual report for the period ending 31 December 2025, reporting total assets at €926.3 million and net assets attributable to unitholders at €450.8 million. The primary artifact is the "By Geography" valuation table showing investment properties valued at €804.3 million as of 31 December 2025, alongside key financial indicators including aggregate leverage of 44.6% and an interest coverage ratio of 2.7 times.

This page presents the **Debt Maturity Profile** as at 31 December 2025, detailing €410.5 million in gross borrowings across five portfolios (Spanish, Decathlon, Fixed Rate Green Notes, B&M, and German) with maturities ranging from December 2026 to July 2029, alongside a table of Net Financial Derivative Assets valued at €4,010 (€'000) representing 0.89% of net assets.

This page presents an Independent Market Review containing the EMEA GDP forecast table (2025–2027), a 30-Year Government Bond Yield table (1998–2026), and Germany-specific data including a GDP index table (2005–2025) and an Office leasing market KPI table for 2025. No audited Portfolio Statement, financial highlights, or tenant/customer tables are present.

This page of the IREIT annual report for the financial year ended 31 December 2025, reporting in S$, details the Annual General Meeting (AGM) and Extraordinary General Meeting (EGM) held on 24 April 2025, including venue, voting results, and minutes published on SGXNet. The main artifacts presented are the Financial Calendar outlining distribution payments and result announcements, a Trading Performance table showing price movements and volume for FY 2024 and FY 2025, and a Total Returns table with distributions reinvested for 1, 3, and 5-year periods.

This page presents a table and chart detailing the closing unit price performance of IREIT Global for the trading period from 1 January 2025 to 31 December 2025, with prices recorded in SGD. The content includes contact information for the manager (Mr Kevin Tan), unit registrar, and unitholder depository but contains no audited portfolio statements, financial results, tenant data, or distribution highlights.

This page presents the **Top-N tenants/customers table** and **trade/tenant mix** for SGX REIT's portfolio as at 31 December 2025, detailing the top 10 tenants (led by Decathlon at 20.8%) and six trade sectors contributing to gross rental income (led by Retail at 38.3%). All figures are reported as percentages of total gross rental income.

This page presents the **Asset Valuation by Property** for SGX REIT's portfolio, detailing property-specific valuations in € million as of 31 December 2024 and 2025 with a total portfolio value of €857.3 million and €798.1 million respectively, alongside a **Lease Expiry by Gross Rental Income** table showing the distribution of lease maturities across fiscal years from FY 2025 through FY 2030 and beyond.

This page presents the audited Portfolio Statement detailing Gross Rental Income by Property for 2024 and 2025, alongside a table of Portfolio Lease Expiry (Number of Years) as at 31 December 2024 and 31 December 2025. The reporting unit is not explicitly defined in the text; however, the data includes property valuations via percentages and lease expiry metrics without monetary figures or currency denominations such as SGD'000 or S$ million.

The portfolio consists of 19 leases, with a footnote noting that the Berlin Campus is excluded from the occupancy rate calculation as it undergoes repositioning.
